larval_development_days_24c.notes: Sum of four reported instar means: 3.3 + 3.1 + 1.8 + 5.9 d.

pupal_development_days_24c.notes: Mean pupal duration at about 24 C.

adult_lifespan_days_24c.notes: Mean adult longevity at about 24 C.

fecundity_eggs_per_female.notes: Mean fecundity; reported range 12-156 eggs/female under study conditions.

female_probability.notes: Laboratory report approximately 2:1 female:male ratio; condition-dependent.

body_mass.summary: Adult live body weight now has a species-specific laboratory anchor; larval stage mass/allometry remains weak.

adult_female_wet_mass_mg.notes: Mean adult female body weight measured within 24 h of emergence (n=30).

adult_male_wet_mass_mg.notes: Mean adult male body weight measured within 24 h of emergence (n=30).

larval_wet_mass_mg.notes: No direct B. impatiens larval mass anchor is frozen.

water_dependence.summary: Eggs/larvae depend on moist substrate; runtime pool-to-suitability mapping remains calibrated.

thermal_response.summary: Development was measured across a broad temperature range; 24 C is a reference condition, not a universal optimum.

reference_temperature_c.notes: Approximate reference condition of the detailed life-history study.

activity_layer: larvae in substrate/root zone; adults above substrate

larval_feeding_carbon_rate.notes: Larval feeding ecology is supported, but this carbon rate is not directly measured.

fungus_preference.notes: Model allocation preference, not a measured choice probability.

adult_carbon_target_mg.notes: Current carbon target predates the species-specific wet-mass anchor; should be revisited through an explicit wet/dry/carbon conversion proposal, not silently changed.

preoviposition_hours.notes: Bounded implementation value inside evidence of <24 h with males present.

immature_survival_probability.notes: Aggregate laboratory immature survival applied at emergence because stage-specific survival is unavailable.

notes: Priority proposal: use the 0.42/0.23 mg adult wet-mass measurements to derive a defensible sex-specific carbon range; keep the existing 0.03 mg_C runtime target until conversion assumptions are reviewed.
Larval feeding rate remains a calibration parameter; no direct species-specific carbon ingestion rate was found.

adult_female_length_mm.notes: Mean female length within 24 h after emergence.

adult_male_length_mm.notes: Mean male length within 24 h after emergence.

mature_larva_length_mm.notes: Extension order-of-magnitude mature larval length; suitable for render scaling but lower confidence than the adult measurements.

render.coloration: Adults are dark gray to black; larvae are translucent/whitish with a dark head capsule.
stage_differences: Eggs small and pale; elongate larvae; immobile pupa; winged adult with marked sexual size difference.
render.locomotion_style: Larvae crawl through substrate; adults perform short erratic flights and surface walking.
reference_images_asset_notes: Use adult sexual dimorphism from measured length data; larval scale remains a lower-confidence render proxy.
